# The Law Offices of Nigel Burns

> > Los Angeles trial law firm specializing in family law, personal injury, probate litigation, and elder abuse cases throughout California.

The Law Offices of Nigel Burns provides comprehensive legal representation in Los Angeles and Orange County, with particular expertise in child custody disputes, property division, adoption proceedings, personal injury claims, and estate litigation. The firm handles complex civil litigation matters and advocates for vulnerable populations including accident victims and elderly clients.
